title: tilia illyrica
intro: Tilia illyrica, commonly known as the Illyrian linden tree, is a deciduous tree native to the Balkan Peninsula and parts of Eastern Europe. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing anxiety and insomnia, lowering blood pressure, and exhibiting antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Tilia illyrica can be attributed to its ability to act as a sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic, making it useful in treating nervous disorders and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Tilia illyrica include flavonoids, such as quercetin and kaempferol, which contribute to its health-promoting and therapeutic properties.
